summary: All 9 corners report setup TNS 0.0 and hold TNS 0.0. Worst setup slack is 8.9381 ns (max_ss_100C_1v60); worst hold slack is 0.104 ns (min_ff_n40C_1v95). The only DRV entries are max fanout on 8 clock-tree buffers (11 to 17 vs limit 10), allowed by the tool's clock-tree rule (limit 20). Hold is the thinnest margin.
assumptions: Absence of max transition/capacitance entries in drv_violators is read as none reported by the tool.
All items assigned to Orion as in the tool output; no Grid-owned items.
All numbers are quoted from reports/power_tool.json; no tool was run by me.
All numbers are taken from reports/sta_tool.json as given; I ran no tool.
Corners evaluated are exactly those in the tool data: tt_025C_1v80, ss_100C_1v60, ff_n40C_1v95.
Electromigration, dynamic/transient IR and package inductance are not analyzed by the open flow.
IR limit is 5% of the 1.8 V supply = 0.09 V (A.13 Phase 0 default), as given in the tool data.
Input switching activity is 0.2 (20% toggle rate, the default), not simulation activity.
Instance names such as _764_ are not resolved to cell types; the synchronizer identification of _764_ is inferred from the spec, not from the data.
Near-min-width edge share on li is treated as inherent to minimum-width local routing, hence low value.
Order within the same severity is my judgment: line-end defect risk above CMP density margin; lows ordered by near-min-space exposure and layer density.
PDK sky130A and library sky130_fd_sc_hd are DEFAULT choices pending G1 review.
Severities from the tool are fixed and were not changed.
The tool's classification of the clock buffer fanout entries under 'clock-tree net, limit 20' is accepted as given, without any waiver added by me.
Voltage source locations and the IR analysis corner/tool are not stated in the input data, so no claim is made about them.
open_issues: Clock-tree buffers exceed the SDC max fanout of 10 (up to 17); reviewer to confirm the clock-tree limit of 20 is acceptable.
EM is not checked by the open flow.
Hold slack is only 0.104 ns at min_ff_n40C_1v95; the data has no hold path list, so limiting hold paths are unknown.
IO delay values and other SDC numbers are DEFAULT placeholders pending G1 review.
IR source locations, corner and tool are not documented in the input data; a human should confirm them before signoff.
OpenLane total power (0.0005702339112758636 W) differs from the sta tt total (0.0005809897 W); the cause (tool, activity or corner) is not stated in the data.
Simulation-based activity is not available; 20% default activity may over- or under-estimate real power.
Spec marks power targets out of scope, so there is no power limit to check against.
Whether Orion should apply non-default rules for the low near-limit items is a human decision at G3; they are not recommended as blockers.
worst_paths lists only setup (max) paths and no cell-level delay breakdown, so dominant cells cannot be named.
